## Scaleweaver Swarm (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
N Fine vermin (swarm)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 36, touch 19, flat-footed 35 (+1 Dex, +17 natural, +8 size)  
**hp** 273 (21d8+105)  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +8, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** swarm traits  
**DR** 10/—; **Immune** acid, cold, disease, fire, mind-affecting effects, poison, weapon damage; **Resist** electricity 10, sonic 30  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., climb 20 ft.  
**Melee** swarm (5d6 plus distraction and poison)  
**Special Attacks** cling, distraction (DC 25)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 5, **Dex** 13, **Con** 20, Int —, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +15; CMB—; CMD—  
**Skills** Climb +9; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb, uses Dex on Climb checks  


**Special Abilities**


**Cling (Ex)** If a creature leaves a scaleweaver swarm’s square, the swarm takes 2d6 points of damage to reflect the loss of its numbers as several scaleweavers cling to the victim.
